name: simplebeacon-local-agent
description: Local agent that lets the SimpleBeacon web dashboard scan local filesystem paths.

scripts.package: npm run build && pkg package.json --out-path dist
scripts.package:portable: npm run build && npm run build:portable
scripts.build:msi: candle windows-installer.wxs -o dist/simplebeacon-local-agent.wixobj && light dist/simplebeacon-local-agent.wixobj -o dist/simplebeacon-local-agent.msi
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:portable && npm run build:setup && npm run build:msi && npm run build:deb
scripts.package:installer: npm run build && npm run build:portable && npm run build:setup
